title: Agricultural Science Field Trip Guidelines
reason: Provides a structured plan for educational agricultural field trips.

tasks.task: Describe the structure of the educational agricultural field trip plan.

subtasks.text: Listen to the introduction of R&R Technologies and the presentation on the excursion to a commercial farm.

tasks.task: Outline the first activity of the field trip.

subtasks.text: Notice the requirement for students to visit a commercial farm and a subsistence farm.
Observe the need for students to list all the machinery, implements, equipment, and tools found during the commercial farm visit.

tasks.task: Highlight the second activity of the field trip.

subtasks.text: Note the visit to a farm workshop and the requirement to list the tools used there.
Pay attention to the detail that students must state the functions of each tool listed in the workshop.

tasks.task: Describe the third activity of the field trip.

subtasks.text: Observe students visiting a nearby farm and identifying one disease on a legume or beverage plant.
Notice the need to name the causal organism of each identified plant disease.

tasks.task: Outline the fourth and final activity of the field trip.

subtasks.text: Listen to the instruction for students to find different types of weeds on the farm.
Observe the requirement for students to create a weed album.
